title: Lead site profile
description: Everything generate.mjs needs to build a tailored one-page site for a prospect. Fill from PRH data + your own research (their Facebook page, old site, phone call).

name.description: Business name as it should appear on the site

slug.description: Output folder / temp domain slug. Auto-derived from name if omitted.

industryKey.description: Key from config.json targetIndustries; selects the default color palette

industryLabel.description: Human label shown in the hero kicker (bold template), e.g. 'Autokorjaamo'

founded.description: Founding year — shown in about/JSON-LD, strong trust signal

siteUrl.description: Final production URL. Set after go-live; enables canonical link and absolute JSON-LD urls.

stats.description: 2-4 hero trust numbers, e.g. {value:'15+', label:'vuotta kokemusta'}. Only claims you can verify.

process.description: 3-4 steps of how an engagement works ('Näin yhteistyö etenee')

priceList.description: Transparent 'alkaen' pricing rows — a major expertise signal. Leave empty in demos unless prices are public knowledge; never invent a prospect's prices.

priceNote.description: VAT note / disclaimer under the price table

testimonials.description: REAL quotes only, with permission. Omit entirely in cold demos.

certifications.description: Verifiable credentials only: vakuutukset, kortit, jäsenyydet, Tilaajavastuu

faq.description: 4-6 questions customers actually ask. Rendered as <details> + FAQPage JSON-LD.

demoBanner.description: true while pitching: shows the 'this is a proposal' bar and sets robots noindex. Set false only after the business buys.

agency.description: Your contact info for the demo banner
